correctness.rationale: A Legendre digit-sum calculation reconstructs the exact valuations in every prime-power block for p coprime to m, including t=0,P-1. Every interior has valuation r-vp(t(t+1))+2h_b; exact counts of disjoint p-adic shells give the polynomial. Rational summation is checked algebraically, and a Haar-p-adic coupling differs from the required row only on two residues of probability 2/p^r. The 202 independent small exact rows agree with the formula; no finite verification is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The 2005 number-theory literature explicitly motivates understanding full p-adic orders for Narayana entries. This result computes the entire valuation spectrum of every p-free prime-power-dilated row using only two small carry-polynomials, gives a rational generating series in the dilation exponent, and a quantitative total-variation limit with a nontrivial m-dependent shift mixture (e.g. m=p+1). It solves an infinite natural family of row-level arithmetic distribution questions without enumerating all mp^r coefficients; it is neither a one-number table extension nor the previously known m=1 case.
